detail.name: unnormalized_weight
detail.reason: The contract requires W=Z^-1 exp(-F); an unnormalized density is not the declared L2(W) state weight.

detail.name: sign_reversed_gibbs_weight
detail.reason: exp(+F) is not PAH-001's lower-F-has-larger-weight convention and is outside the hash-pinned contract.

detail.name: zero_observable_weight
detail.reason: A weight that annihilates any of ell_a, ell_d, H_0 or H_1 violates the nonzero-norm rule.

detail.name: fixed_R_max_only
detail.reason: The target quantifies R_max=R over all positive integers; a finite list cannot establish the stated uniform supremum.

detail.name: omit_inverse_root
detail.reason: The AM-GM step needs the source-declared inverse-pair bijection; dropping an inverse changes the root domain and is not PAH-001.

detail.name: mobility_or_rate_change
detail.reason: Changing mobility, midpoint sign or rates violates the parent dynamics and the preservation firewall.

detail.name: counterterm_or_averaging_rescue
detail.reason: A counterterm, averaging map or fixed-cutoff bypass is explicitly forbidden.

detail.name: envelope_implies_intertwining
detail.reason: The finite envelope is only a local-form coefficient input; rootwise/eventual generator intertwining remains separate.

detail.name: physical_promotion
detail.reason: The contract and both runs retain the no-physics firewall.
